title: Test the real _persistNotificationSettingsToCloud signature logic, not a hand-copied reimplementation
why: _persistNotificationSettingsToCloud's M2 no-op-skip logic (skip pushing when the settings signature hasn't changed, to avoid bumping updated_at and clobbering a newer remote under LWW -- the exact mechanism the client-clock finding depends on) is a private function, so G1-G4 reimplement its string format by hand in the test file instead of exercising it. If a future edit to the real signature-building code drops a field or changes the separator, breaking the no-op-skip contract, G1-G4 keep passing because they never call the real function.
recommendation: Extract the signature-building into an internal @visibleForTesting function the tests can call directly, or drive it end-to-end via notificationSettingsCloudSyncEffectProvider with a fake outbox facade asserting enqueue is/isn't called across setting changes.
acceptance_criteria: A mutation check confirms G1-G4 (or their replacement) fail when a field is removed from the real signature-building code in notification_providers.dart.
